articles.title: Visa outlines stablecoin strategy during Q3 earnings call
articles.snippet: Visa said it is investing across the stablecoin stack, highlighting OpenUSD, tokenized deposits and AI-powered commerce during the company’s third-quarter earnings call.

articles.title: AmericanFortress proposes quantum-safe crypto wallet protection without fund migration
articles.snippet: The proposed cryptographic scheme aims to protect existing Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana wallets from future quantum attacks without requiring users to move funds or change wallet addresses.

articles.title: Russia Charges Telegram's Pavel Durov With Aiding Terrorism
articles.snippet: Durov has previously called Russia’s criminal case against him "a sad spectacle of a state afraid of its own people."

articles.title: Claude Mythos Cracked Post-Quantum Cryptography That Humans Spent Years Failing to Break
articles.snippet: Anthropic’s locked model found a new attack on a post-quantum signature scheme headed for U.S. federal standardization.

articles.title: Michael Saylor: Bitcoin Code Is a Constitution, Changes Are Attacks on 'Economic Rights'
articles.snippet: The Strategy chairman's latest thread extends his war far beyond BIP-110: now covenants, larger blocks, and any base-layer change are all the same "constitutional offense."
